name: deny_ptrace
description: Deny every process the ptrace capability: debuggers, strace and crash handlers stop working for users and services alike.

name: deny_execmem
description: Deny memory that is writable and executable at once. Breaks JIT compilers in browsers, Java and some Electron applications.

name: selinuxuser_execstack
description: Allow unconfined user programs an executable stack. Off is the hardened value; some legacy and Wine programs need it on.

name: selinuxuser_execheap
description: Allow unconfined user programs an executable heap. Off by default and rarely needed.

name: selinuxuser_execmod
description: Allow unconfined user programs to load libraries that need text relocation. Off breaks some third-party binaries.

name: domain_can_mmap_files
description: Allow every domain to mmap files it may read, instead of only the domains with an explicit rule.

name: secure_mode_insmod
description: Disable kernel module loading for every domain once the system is up.

name: domain_kernel_load_modules
description: Allow all domains to load kernel modules through the kernel's request mechanism.

name: unconfined_login
description: Allow logins to run as the unconfined user. Off confines every interactive session, which breaks sudo and most desktop sessions unless the users are mapped to confined SELinux users first.

name: user_exec_content
description: Allow confined users (user_u) to run programs from their home and temporary directories.

name: staff_exec_content
description: Allow staff users (staff_u) to run programs from their home and temporary directories.

name: guest_exec_content
description: Allow guest users (guest_u) to run programs from their home and temporary directories.

name: xguest_connect_network
description: Allow the xguest kiosk user to connect to the network with a browser.

name: xguest_exec_content
description: Allow the xguest kiosk user to run programs from the home directory.

name: xguest_mount_media
description: Allow the xguest kiosk user to mount removable media.

name: xguest_use_bluetooth
description: Allow the xguest kiosk user to use Bluetooth devices.

name: ssh_sysadm_login
description: Allow sysadm_u users to log in over SSH directly.

name: polyinstantiation_enabled
description: Give every user a private /tmp and /var/tmp through PAM namespaces.

name: use_nfs_home_dirs
description: Allow users and desktop services to use home directories on NFS. Required for NFS or autofs homes.

name: use_samba_home_dirs
description: Allow users and desktop services to use home directories on CIFS/SMB shares.

name: use_ecryptfs_home_dirs
description: Allow home directories encrypted with eCryptfs.

name: use_fusefs_home_dirs
description: Allow home directories on FUSE file systems (sshfs, davfs).

name: samba_enable_home_dirs
description: Allow the Samba server to share users' home directories.

name: selinuxuser_share_music
description: Allow users to share their music directory through a media server.

name: cups_execmem
description: Allow the CUPS printing daemon writable and executable memory, needed by some printer drivers.

name: deny_bluetooth
description: Deny every domain the use of Bluetooth sockets.

name: selinuxuser_ping
description: Allow unconfined users to run ping and traceroute.

name: selinuxuser_tcp_server
description: Allow unconfined user programs to listen on TCP ports.

name: selinuxuser_udp_server
description: Allow unconfined user programs to listen on UDP ports.

name: selinuxuser_direct_dri_enabled
description: Allow users direct access to the graphics hardware (DRI).

name: mozilla_plugin_can_network_connect
description: Allow confined browser plug-ins to open network connections.

name: mozilla_read_content
description: Allow the confined Firefox domain to read user content outside its own directories.

name: kerberos_enabled
description: Allow confined services to use Kerberos authentication.

name: authlogin_nsswitch_use_ldap
description: Allow name service lookups (users, groups) against an LDAP directory.

name: authlogin_yubikey
description: Allow PAM to talk to YubiKey hardware tokens.

name: authlogin_radius
description: Allow PAM to authenticate against a RADIUS server.

name: nis_enabled
description: Allow NIS (yp) lookups; also loosens port rules for many services.

name: virt_use_usb
description: Allow virtual machines to use USB devices.

name: virt_use_nfs
description: Allow virtual machine images on NFS.

name: virt_use_samba
description: Allow virtual machine images on CIFS/SMB shares.

name: virt_sandbox_use_all_caps
description: Allow sandbox containers all capabilities.

name: container_manage_cgroup
description: Allow containers to manage cgroups (systemd inside containers).

name: container_use_devices
description: Allow containers to use any device.

name: container_connect_any
description: Allow containers to connect to any TCP port.

name: httpd_can_network_connect
description: Allow a local web server to open outbound network connections.
